author: Space_Ace
what_it_is: Ruby Save: Hop in the ship and ram the little red thing nearby. The 2 dead characters is a tactic so Ruby wont send any members out of the fight. Either wait until Red XIII is killed cause he has Phoenix junctioned to Final Attack, or just Revive them.
format: DexDrive .gme: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header (per-block comments) + 131072-byte raw card; the card holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASCUS-94163FF7-S03)
